caption: 「你前世女兒的生日是幾號？」
scene: A trendy young streamer with styled hair in a streetwear hoodie holding a phone on a selfie stick, smirking with a polite but sharp smile, thrusting the phone toward a man in his 40s with messy slightly curly hair, round glasses and a navy blue hoodie with a small ladybug pin, who sits frozen in a livestream studio under harsh ring lights, his face pale with shock.

caption: 「想一下？這個 bug 找不到喔？」
scene: Close-up of the man in his 40s with round glasses and a navy blue hoodie, mouth slightly open, sweat beading on his forehead, eyes darting in panic, the livestream studio lights casting hard shadows on his face as a blurred phone screen glows in the foreground.

caption: 「哥……那個區塊，是空的。」
scene: A small cute blonde hologram girl with blue eyes in an oversized white hoodie, translucent and glowing cyan, hovering beside a coffee mug on a desk, her shoulders trembling and eyes welling with tears, her glow flickering dimly in a dark office at night.

caption: 「每次大算力，就燒掉你一段記憶。」
scene: The hologram girl glowing cyan looks up with tearful blue eyes at the man in round glasses and navy blue hoodie, who stands still and silent by a rain-streaked window, the city lights blurred outside, a faint battery bar projected in the air between them, moody blue lighting.

caption: 「那就燒。全部燒光也沒關係。」
scene: The man in his 40s with messy curly hair and round glasses stands tall by the window, smiling gently and calmly, one hand adjusting his glasses, rain droplets on the glass behind him, warm desk lamp glow contrasting the cold blue night, the tiny hologram girl staring up at him in awe.

caption: 「朋友來，不能寒酸。」
scene: An elderly Taiwanese grandmother with curly grey hair and a floral apron smiles warmly, ladling a braised egg into a bowl placed in front of a pair of round glasses on a plastic table, steam rising from a bubbling pot, warm yellow lantern light in a rainy street food stall at night.

caption: 「……好香喔。」
scene: The small blonde hologram girl in an oversized white hoodie sits quietly in front of a steaming bowl of braised pork rice, translucent cyan glow mixing with warm steam, her eyes glistening with tears and a soft sad smile, the man in navy blue hoodie eating with his head down across from her, intimate night stall lighting.

caption: 「那八支的檔名……是你的名字。」
scene: Extreme close-up of the hologram girl's pale terrified face glowing cyan in the dark office, a floating holographic alert panel with a glowing timestamp hovering before the man in round glasses and navy hoodie, whose eyes widen in dread, deep shadows and cold blue light.
